_comment: Generated by sfdx-devops-kit. Project-scoped MCP servers for Claude Code.
Credentials are NOT stored here: BACKLOG_DOMAIN and BACKLOG_API_KEY are read
from your shell environment and passed through to the container.
export BACKLOG_API_KEY=...        # Backlog: personal settings > API
Issue an API key per person, never a shared one.
NOTE on --enable-toolsets: it must be repeated once per toolset. The
comma-separated form shown in some documentation ('space,project,issue')
matches no toolset and leaves the server with ZERO tools (verified against
backlog-mcp-server v0.20.4). Omit the flag entirely to enable all 63 tools.
